correctness.rationale: Cactus spanning trees contain each bridge and omit one edge of every cycle, yielding exact product factorization and homogeneous block degrees 1 or l-1 totaling n-1. Injectivity of edge weights into grounded Laplacian for simple graph plus strict logdet concavity proves global uniqueness on positive-tree domain, including boundary. Scaling each positive block gives d_H B/(n-1); one-sided KKT derivative at unique zero face is (l-1)/D Σ_{e≠k}p_e and multiplier (l-1)/D, proving sharp iff. Differentiation gives one-exception a,b. Independently rationally checked 7-vertex cofactor 27/98 and 35 priced-cycle KKT cases. Numerical checks alone cannot establish all graphs.
